Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows a small, hypoplastic right lung with opacity and dextroposition of the heart (shift to the right), alongside a curved vascular shadow (indicated by the arrow) resembling a scimitar. These findings, supported by the CT images showing right-sided anomalies, are classic for Scimitar syndrome (congenital pulmonary venolobar syndrome), which often includes right lung hypoplasia/aplasia and anomalous venous drainage.
